title: The protocol for the direct reprogramming therapy of human liver cancer cells with only chemicals
protocol: Obtain human liver cancer samples with informed consent from patients who underwent liver transplantation.
Evaluate AKR1B10 expression in human HCC samples using an AKR1B10 antibody.
Incubate the liver cancer cells in a flask coated with collagen gel in a CO2 incubator at 37°C for 24 hours.
Collect viable cells adhering to the collagen gel and resuspend them in reconstituted type 1 collagen solution for a final density of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Place three drops of the collagen-cell mixture in each well of a 6-well plate in a 60 mm dish.
Allow the plates to reach 37°C in a CO2 incubator for 1 hour.
Add culture medium to each well after allowing the droplets to solidify and settle.
Incubate the plate in a CO2 incubator at 37°C overnight.
Add 10 μM ACR to the cells for 2 days.
Add 10 μM zopolrestat to the cells for 2 days.
Add 10 μM ACR and 10 μM zopolrestat to the cells for 2 days.
Determine albumin protein concentration in culture media by ELISA using goat anti-human albumin.
Perform quantitative analysis of AFP secretion with AFP Amerlex-M RIA detection kit.
Measure oxygen consumption (mean ± SD, nmol min-1 mg-1 protein) in AKR1B10-positive liver cancer cells 3 days after administration of drugs.
Measure oxygen consumption (mean ± SD, nmol min-1 mg-1 protein) in AKR1B10-negative liver cancer cells 3 days after administration of drugs.
Conduct statistical tests with Dr. SPSS II for Windows.
